answer: Give each new identity exactly one entry vertex in the transaction graph, earned by solving a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to a verified hardware key. Honest agents solve one puzzle once; a Sybil farmer must burn real compute for every fake vertex, like raising a dune grain by grain. Submissions arriving in machine-gun bursts under umber timing patterns get throttled into manual review, so each extra sockpuppet costs more than the last.
